title: TickPulse Ingestion
description: Binance aggTrade ingestion: throughput per symbol, ingest lag, WebSocket health, channel backpressure and database writes.

panels.title: WebSocket
panels.description: Current state of the Binance WebSocket connection (Standby = this instance is not the leader).

panels.title: Role
panels.description: Whether this instance holds the ingestion leader lock.

panels.title: Ticks / s
panels.description: Trades received from Binance per second, all selected symbols.

panels.title: Ingest lag p95
panels.description: Time from Binance trade time to the row being persisted, 95th percentile.

panels.title: Channel depth
panels.description: Ticks waiting in the bounded channel between the WebSocket reader and the batch writer (capacity 100k).

panels.title: Reconnects
panels.description: Unplanned WebSocket reconnects in the selected time range (planned 23 h rotations are excluded).

panels.title: Ticks received per symbol
panels.description: Trades received from the Binance stream per second.

panels.title: Database write rate
panels.description: Ticks persisted per second (binary COPY + insert), stacked by symbol, with batch flushes per second on the right axis.

panels.title: Ticks per symbol
panels.description: Trades received per symbol in the selected time range.

panels.title: Ingest lag
panels.description: Binance trade time → persisted, p50 / p95 / p99. The dashed line is the 5 s alert threshold.

panels.title: Ingest lag distribution
panels.description: How many ticks landed in each lag bucket over time.

panels.title: Channel depth
panels.description: Backlog in the ingestion channel. Sustained growth means the database cannot keep up.

panels.title: Flush duration
panels.description: Time to write one batch (COPY into staging, insert, candle upsert).

panels.title: Batch size
panels.description: Ticks per flushed batch (flushes happen every 500 ms or at 5,000 ticks).

panels.title: Connection state
panels.description: WebSocket state and leader role over time.

panels.title: Connections by reason
panels.description: New WebSocket connections: initial connect, reconnect after a failure, or the planned 23 h rotation.

panels.title: Backfill rate
panels.description: 1-minute klines imported from Binance REST per second (feeds long-period SMAs only).

panels.title: Candles backfilled
panels.description: Klines imported per symbol in the selected time range.

panels.title: Gap-fill trades recovered
panels.description: Trades fetched over REST after a reconnect to close the gap (zero data loss).

panels.title: Recent ingestion spans
panels.description: Latest batch-flush, backfill and gap-fill traces. Click a trace ID to open it.
